title: The Guest
review: The movie that dares to ask the question we were all thinking about: what if {John Wick} but silly? It's not a horror movie, but a low-budget action thriller set during Halloween. The premise is so good, and David is handled so well. The tone was just right for me: complex and intriguing, without any explicit jokes, but knowingly dumb. It's not trying to be the best possible action movie, nor is it satirising the genre by highlighting its absurdities. It's just a good time to watch once, and enjoy, knowing that it's not good enough to think about too much or rewatch. I saw it because I want to see {Onslaught}, its loosely-connected spiritual successor.
